title: Wood Staff
description: A simple staff that lets you conjure up wood on the go!
body:
### **_Wood Staff_** 
...is a simple Vanilla+ mod that adds a new craftable item to the game that, upon right-clicking, allows you to change any block (excluding bedrock) to an oak log up to 64 times. For a relatively low crafting price, you can carry around an item that provides the ability to change any block into an oak log at will. Even in creating a large project, this tool may be useful.

![Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ba87233ea4944f90e891b9de9422aff652086e61.png)
